body:
> Eod · 2026-06-20

Saturday. Summit blog page polish and Alphalete local page fixes.

# Summit Plumbing Pros AZ
See [Summit Plumbing Pros AZ (Hub)](lib:brain-summit-plumbing-pros-az-hub).
- Blog page: fixed blurry featured images (size Large) and cut-off banners (ratio 0.52), removed the Archives widget.
- Added a Blog link to the footer nav.

# Alphalete Trenchless
See [Alphalete Trenchless (Hub)](lib:brain-alphalete-trenchless-hub).
- Fixed wrong ZIP codes on 10 trenchless sewer repair local pages (Denver, Colorado Springs, Pueblo, Castle Rock, Parker, Monument, Fountain, Canon City, Guffey, Littleton), verified live.
- Created Google Drive files: Local Pages Indexing Tracker, Wrong ZIP Codes Audit (93 pages), Littleton and Lone Tree local page drafts.
- Wove one unique local paragraph into 8 of 10 Littleton and Lone Tree pages via Elementor (2 already localized were skipped).

# Follow-ups
- 83 of 93 Alphalete wrong-ZIP pages remain.
- 3 Lone Tree pages still show Colorado Springs ZIPs.
- Hydro Lone Tree page has draft instructions visible live; needs cleanup.
